purpose: Every pair below MUST be reported as distinct. Each row names a collapse that a plausible implementation would make, the correct separation, and the exact field or state that carries it.

noncollapse_matrix.why_tempting: Both are called NONCOMPARABLE and both are refusals.
noncollapse_matrix.correct_separation: They concern different objects. SOURCE_NONCOMPARABLE asks whether the underlying fact is comparable; TEMPORAL_NONCOMPARABLE asks whether the ORDERED PAIR is comparable in time under bound authority.
noncollapse_matrix.source_side_ref: EMPIRICAL_FACT_NONCOMPARABLE produced at rawlsing_next/pre553_structural_admission.py:639-640,680-681 from fact.typed_state == NONCOMPARABLE; NONCOMPARABLE enumerated at rawlsing_next/pre553_empirical_objects.py:79,88
noncollapse_matrix.carrier: relation_state vs the source-side decision list; they are never the same field
noncollapse_matrix.concrete_case: A pair of anchors from two source universes with no authorized equivalence is TEMPORAL_NONCOMPARABLE, while each underlying fact may be individually comparable and usable under non-temporal rules.

noncollapse_matrix.why_tempting: A refused comparison produces no delta, and a naive renderer would emit zero or 'no change'.
noncollapse_matrix.correct_separation: TEMPORAL_NONCOMPARABLE is a refusal, never a finding. NONCOMPARABLE != NO_CHANGE.
noncollapse_matrix.carrier: non_delta_presence = DELTA_NOT_CLAIMABLE, which is explicitly not a zero
noncollapse_matrix.historical_support: Conserved V553 semantics: is_limit true, temporal_effect 'blocks relation/delta use; no temporal F1', non_temporal_effect 'does not erase independent fact' (data/ddm_build_copy/vozhd_dva/20260817_downstream_completion/schematics/advisory/PRE_S01_5_V554_ARCHITECTURE/RESULT.json)

noncollapse_matrix.why_tempting: If the pair cannot be compared, a naive implementation might record that nothing is there.
noncollapse_matrix.correct_separation: A temporal limit does not erase the underlying facts. does_not_negate_original_fact = true. A separate non-temporal rule may still lawfully use the original fact.
noncollapse_matrix.carrier: relation_state carries is_limit and does_not_negate_original_fact as explicit contract fields
noncollapse_matrix.authority: HQ206 adjudication binding: the conserved V554 law states a temporal candidate with TEMPORAL_NONCOMPARABLE has no temporal F1, while an independent non-temporal V552 rule may still create F1 ELIGIBLE

noncollapse_matrix.why_tempting: If a pair is comparable, a renderer may assume a direction is then available.
noncollapse_matrix.correct_separation: A comparable pair under a partial order has NO claimable direction. Comparability and order are separate facts.
noncollapse_matrix.concrete_case: Two overlapping authorized intervals are comparable but yield only a partial order, so DIRECTION_NOT_CLAIMABLE.

noncollapse_matrix.why_tempting: A positive authorization state could be rendered directly as a direction.
noncollapse_matrix.correct_separation: TEMPORAL_DIRECTIONAL_CLAIM_AUTHORIZED says a claim MAY be made. direction_claim separately says what it is. Two fields, never merged.

noncollapse_matrix.why_tempting: Both indicate 'nothing to report about direction'.
noncollapse_matrix.correct_separation: NO_AUTHORIZED_CHANGE is a positive finding that no change was claimable under a bound deadband. DIRECTION_NOT_CLAIMABLE is a refusal. One is evidence, the other is a limit.

noncollapse_matrix.why_tempting: A series of ordered comparisons looks like a path over time.
noncollapse_matrix.correct_separation: DIFFERENCE != TRAJECTORY is a binding noncollapse rule. No trajectory object is authorized. A longer chain is a SEQUENCE of separate two-anchor receipts, not a distinct object.
noncollapse_matrix.carrier: Absence of any trajectory field; anchor_refs is exactly cardinality 2
f7_must_not_revive: any rendering of a joint/diff product as a trajectory (historically forbidden)
noncollapse_matrix.tension_named: F7 must-not-revive lists 'trajectory requires >=3 anchors' as forbidden. This contract instead asserts that two anchors suffice for ONE ordered relation. The two are compatible: neither a >=3 law nor a trajectory object is adopted, and two-anchor sufficiency is about a single ordered comparison, not about trajectory composition.

noncollapse_matrix.why_tempting: A prior record might import a >=3-anchor requirement as a sufficiency threshold.
noncollapse_matrix.correct_separation: Two anchors are SUFFICIENT for one ordered relation when all comparability authority is present. TEMPORAL_INSUFFICIENT_ANCHORS exists ONLY for fewer than two. There is NO state for three-or-more.
noncollapse_matrix.authority: HQ206 adjudication: 'two anchors may suffice for one ordered relation when all comparability authority is present'; '>=3 anchors is not law'

noncollapse_matrix.why_tempting: A wave has a label, an ordinal and often an associated year, so a renderer may substitute them.
noncollapse_matrix.correct_separation: Three distinct quantities. The label is canonical and preserved; the ordinal is derived only for range comparison without changing the label; the calendar year is separate.
noncollapse_matrix.carrier: temporal_identity_contract_ref composition must preserve all three; family_wave_label never coerced
noncollapse_matrix.mandated_by: HQ206 commission: Preserve WAVE_LABEL != ORDINAL != CALENDAR_YEAR

noncollapse_matrix.why_tempting: Overlapping intervals are awkward, so a renderer may collapse them to a midpoint to get an order.
noncollapse_matrix.correct_separation: Overlap yields a partial order and a typed refusal. Midpoint coercion is forbidden.
noncollapse_matrix.mandated_by: HQ206 commission: Do not coerce overlap to midpoint

noncollapse_matrix.why_tempting: An absent delta or an unobserved span could be rendered as zero.
noncollapse_matrix.correct_separation: Typed absence is never zero. Absent delta means DELTA_NOT_CLAIMABLE. An unobserved span means TEMPORAL_GAP_INTERVENING. OBSERVED_ZERO and ZERO_SUPPORT are already distinguished structurally upstream.

noncollapse_matrix.why_tempting: A measured change across two times is often narrated as being caused by something.
noncollapse_matrix.correct_separation: No causal relation, mechanism, mediation or explanation. The historical event-override slot is 'reserved_not_filled' and remains unfilled.

noncollapse_matrix.would_be_collapsed: RUPTURE CANDIDATE  ==  RUPTURE, or  RUPTURE  ==  DIRECTIONAL CLAIM
noncollapse_matrix.why_tempting: A large change might be rendered as a rupture with a cause.
noncollapse_matrix.correct_separation: A typed candidate only, under exact authority, with no causal attribution and no V553 threshold imported. It is not a directional claim and not an ordered relation.

noncollapse_matrix.would_be_collapsed: THE FIVE FUNCTIONS  ==  ONE AUTHORITY KIND
noncollapse_matrix.why_tempting: A single new authority kind could be made to carry identity, observation, comparison, rupture and gap.
noncollapse_matrix.correct_separation: Only the comparison/order law is owned. Identity and gap reference existing forms; observation and rupture remain separate producer responsibilities.
noncollapse_matrix.mandated_by: HQ206 commission: Do not accidentally collapse five functions into TEMPORAL_COMPARABILITY if separate ownership is cleaner

noncollapse_matrix.would_be_collapsed: COMPARABILITY  ==  GRAIN ADEQUACY BY FAMILY MEMBERSHIP
noncollapse_matrix.why_tempting: Two anchors from the same survey family are obviously comparable.
noncollapse_matrix.correct_separation: Same-family membership does not by itself prove grain adequacy. Adequacy is per-claim and per-authority, and every comparability surface must be jointly satisfied.

refusal_matrix.note: Every nonpositive outcome is terminal, typed, reason-carrying and replayable. No state is silent, and no nonpositive state is ever evidence of no change.

rows.condition: temporal identity key not jointly composed
comparability surface not shared (response, scale, instrument, question, geography, population, measure, order basis, time representation)
pair crosses source universes without authorized equivalence
family-scoped time mapping required but unadopted
order basis yields only a partial order and the pair is otherwise comparable
rows.note: Comparability is positive; only direction is refused.

rows.condition: authority snapshot hash or scope mismatch
rows.note: Reused existing FAIL_CLOSED_STATES; no new state created.
Preserved as typed unknown; forbids continuity, trend, rate and interpolation.

no_silent_paths: no clock, RNG or filesystem state in resolution
no inherited V553 threshold or deadband
no backfill into a noncomparable pair
